recommendation_note: run16 uses the v5b_sharp1023_midflat70 bank with impulse gentle fraction 0.3 for both rate families. Evidence is regenerated under gate spec 7, which bounds the square plateau window by the probe's own half period: the spec 6 fixed 0.1-0.8 ms window straddled the next transition from 625 Hz upward, so the row previously advertised as run16's worst binding probe (square_2000hz plateau_rms, 4.7% / 6.3% margin) was measuring the square wave rather than its ripple. Under spec 7 both families still pass G1-G9 on CPU and strict-FP32 CUDA, and the true ringing margin is 59-61%. Squares above 1666.7 Hz now carry no plateau row; closing that coverage gap needs a probe manifest revision.
